predictions.selection_reason: RLE compressed data -> bounds validation -> prevents buffer overrun during decompression
predictions.source_summary: c->rleoffset and c->rlelength come from SGI image file RLE tables (starttab and lengthtab arrays) populated from file data. c->bufsize is the file size minus SGI header size.
predictions.sink_summary: The unchecked values would be used in expandrow/expandrow2 functions as source pointers and lengths for RLE decompression operations.
predictions.guard_summary: The added check prevents buffer overrun by validating that rleoffset + rlelength does not exceed the allocated buffer size. If violated, sets error code and returns early.
predictions.risk_pattern: Bounds check added to prevent reading beyond allocated buffer during RLE decompression of SGI image data.
enclosing_conditions: Loop over image rows (c->rowno) and channels (c->channo)
predictions.context_summary: The check is added in the main decompression loop to validate RLE table entries before they are used to access the compressed data buffer.
unresolved_facts: Whether the RLE table values (starttab/lengthtab) are validated for consistency before this check
Whether there are other potential overflow paths in the decompression functions

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: file format decompression with untrusted offset and length values leading to buffer overrun
retrieval_query.source: SGI image file RLE tables (starttab, lengthtab)
retrieval_query.missing_control: validation of file-supplied offset and length against buffer size
retrieval_query.impact: read beyond allocated buffer, potential information disclosure

top_sast_rules.description: A read accesses memory before or beyond the valid buffer range.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-125 out-of-bounds-read buffer-read memory-read index offset length parser decode malformed-input boundary
top_sast_rules.remediation: Check read offsets, indexes, and lengths before buffer access.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer
top_sast_rules.description: Memory operations access outside the intended buffer boundary.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-119 memory-buffer bounds pointer overflow underflow memcpy strcpy allocation index length out-of-bounds read write
top_sast_rules.remediation: Validate buffer sizes, offsets, indexes, and memory-copy lengths.

top_sast_rules.description: A Unicode transformation is using a remote user-controlled data. The transformation is a Unicode normalization using the algorithms "NFC" or "NFKC". In all cases, the security measures implemented or the logical validation performed to escape any injection characters, to validate using regex patterns or to perform string-based checks, before the Unicode transformation are **bypassable** by special Unicode characters.

top_sast_rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious ZIP file, or similar type of archive, without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can allow an attacker to unexpectedly gain access to resources.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection')
